title: Understanding the Decision Boundary
text: The decision boundary is given by the equation $$2hue+abv=\frac{3}{2}$$. This equation helps us determine the threshold T for classifying the wine type.

title: Relating the Decision Boundary to the Threshold
text: The decision boundary equation $$2hue+abv=\frac{3}{2}$$ is derived from the logistic regression model. The threshold T is related to the decision boundary equation.

title: Expressing the Decision Boundary in Terms of T
text: The decision boundary equation can be expressed in terms of the threshold T as $$2hue+abv=\ln\left(\frac{T}{1-T}\right)$$.

title: Solving for T
text: Given the decision boundary equation $$2hue+abv=\frac{3}{2}$$, solve for T using the relationship $$2hue+abv=\ln\left(\frac{T}{1-T}\right)$$.
